What learning looks like

Start with the fundamentals. Finish with something that moves.

Our current Year 5–6 class is a small beginner group learning Python through a nine-week sequence—from variables and decisions to loops, functions, Turtle graphics and a complete game.

See the curriculum and next-term details →
final_game.py
from turtle import Turtle

player = Turtle()
player.shape("turtle")

def move_right():
    player.forward(20)

screen.listen()
screen.onkey(move_right, "Right")
A final-game concept using functions, keyboard input and animation.
